pages.text: The Mortar's bigger brother: crushes first, falls back to milling.$(br2)Uses its own windup and cycle timings — independent from the Mortar's config.

pages.title: Recipes it can do
pages.text: $(li)Create's $(l)crushing$() recipes (first)$(li)Create's $(l)milling$() recipes (fallback)$(li)Exclusive recipes written for $(o)either$() mortar or crusher mortar$(br)$(br)$(italic)Being an upgraded Mortar is intentional.$()

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)It accepts exclusive recipes whose $(l)tool$() field is $(c)mortar$() as well — you don't need to duplicate them.$(li)Filtering follows $(c)crusher_mortar$() table, even for recipes owned by $(c)mortar$().
